routes.name: Anaphylactic Shock
routes.fa: Matt Christensen, Norm Reid, Mark McGuire (1990)
hazards: Columnar andesite is generally solid but loose material sits on the slopes above the cliff -- watch for rockfall from parties above; rattlesnakes are documented on the approach and at the cliff base; a past rockfall event closed part of this area for over a month, a reminder that exposure to rockfall here is a real, recurring hazard, not just theoretical
routes.overview: An overhanging, leaning corner at the heart of the crag, with strenuous moves in sequence and a committed top-out.
